entries.title: Usage names the OpenRouter model that answered a decision
entries.body: When an OpenRouter decision model sorts new work, Usage now lists the model OpenRouter says answered, such as a dated version of Jev latest, at the cost OpenRouter reported for the call. Before, it listed the model that was asked for, at a cost worked out from listed prices.

picture.alt: Usage details for an OpenRouter decision model named by the dated model that answered, with estimates from the cost the provider reported
